'''Vinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal living on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and working with the [[Old Tion Brotherhood]] and the [[Ziost Liberation Front]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he helped [[Theron Shan]] and [[Gnost-Dural]] in [[Mission to Ziost|their mission]].
